description:
Job Family : 
Data Science & Analysis 
 Travel Required : 
None 
 Clearance Required : 
Ability to Obtain Public Trust 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 Design, develop, configure, and maintain data integration, analytics, and operational solutions using Palantir Foundry and related enterprise data platforms.
 Build and maintain scalable data pipelines, transformations, and reusable data products supporting operational reporting, advanced analytics, AI, and decision support.
 Develop and maintain Palantir Ontology models, business objects, relationships, actions, and workflows that support operational and analytical use cases.
 Design and develop user-facing applications using Foundry Workshops and other Palantir application development capabilities.
 Integrate data from cloud platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and external data sources using scalable and secure integration patterns.
 Develop and optimize solutions using Python, SQL, and other modern programming languages for large-scale data processing and analytics.
 Implement data quality, validation, metadata management, lineage, and governance practices to ensure trusted, reusable, and well-documented data assets.
 Collaborate with data engineers, architects, data scientists, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate mission and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
 Support Agile software development activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
 Prepare technical documentation including system diagrams, data flow diagrams, solution documentation, standard operating procedures, and implementation guides.
 Support technical modernization initiatives involving cloud platforms, enterprise data ecosystems, and AI-enabled analytics solutions.
 Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or higher federal security clearance, as required.
 
 What You Will Need: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
 Experience developing solutions using Palantir Foundry, including data pipelines, transformations, data products, and application development.
 Experience developing Foundry Workshops and operational applications.
 Experience designing and implementing Ontology models supporting operational or analytical workflows.
 Experience integrating structured and unstructured data from multiple enterprise data sources.
 Experience implementing data quality, validation, testing, and governance processes.
 Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google cloud services) and modern enterprise data architectures.
 
 What Would Be Nice To Have: 
 Experience with Palantir Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP).
 Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and DevSecOps best practices.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while delivering high-quality technical solutions.
 Experience implementing enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, and role-based access controls.
 Experience working in fast-paced, matrixed organizations
 Experience integrating Palantir with Databricks, Apache Spark, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric, or AWS services.
 Experience supporting AI/ML, natural language processing, knowledge graphs, semantic search, or advanced analytics solutions.
 Experience supporting public health, healthcare, life sciences, biomedical research, or epidemiology programs.
 Experience working with health data and health data standards such as FHIR, HL7, LOINC, SNOMED CT, or laboratory and surveillance data.
 Experience supporting federal agencies such as CDC, HHS, NIH, CMS, FDA, or VA.
 Experience in consulting environments supporting multidisciplinary technical teams.
 Palantir Foundry, Palantir AIP, Azure, AWS, Databricks, or related technical certifications.
 
 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $85,000.00-$141,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer: 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Parental Leave

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Group Term Life and Travel Assistance

 Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance

 Health Savings Account, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Transit and Parking Commuter Benefits

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development, Certifications & Learning Opportunities

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Care.com annual membership

 Employee Assistance Program

 Supplemental Benefits via Corestream (Critical Care, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Assistance and ID theft protection, etc.)

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 
 About Guidehouse 
 Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
 
 Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.
 
 If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1-571-633-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.
 
 All communication regarding recruitment for a Guidehouse position will be sent from Guidehouse email domains including @guidehouse.com or guidehouse@myworkday.com .  Correspondence received by an applicant from any other domain should be considered unauthorized and will not be honored by Guidehouse.  Note that Guidehouse will never charge a fee or require a money transfer at any stage of the recruitment process and does not collect fees from educational institutions for participation in a recruitment event.
